name: grace-commons-site
description: The Grace Commons site's own stylesheet build: Tailwind, INKs and the jtd-inks theme. Nothing here is a library; the pages are the product.

scripts.dev: npm run css && (trap 'kill 0' INT TERM EXIT; tailwindcss -i tailwind.css -o assets/css/app.css --watch=always & bundle exec jekyll serve --port ${PORT:-4001} --livereload --livereload-port ${LIVERELOAD_PORT:-35729} $JEKYLL_FLAGS; wait)
